title: Debounce Button in Timer ISR
shortDescription: Implement an 8-sample shift-register debouncer with rising/falling edge events.

objectives: Implement an 8-sample shift-register debouncer with rising/falling edge events

hints.nudge: A single sample should not immediately change the debounced state.
hints.approach: Keep sample history separate from the accepted button state. Decide when a history window is stable, then emit an event only when the accepted state changes.

templates.notes: Update history on every ISR call, then detect stable transitions.

visibleCases.name: stable low has no edges
visibleCases.explanation: Noisy logic should not trigger when steady low.

visibleCases.name: bouncy press emits one rise
visibleCases.explanation: Requires 8 stable high samples before accepting press.

visibleCases.name: bouncy release emits one fall
visibleCases.explanation: Requires 8 stable low samples before accepting release.

visibleCases.name: held high does not repeat rise
visibleCases.explanation: Edge events should fire on state transition, not continuously.

hiddenCases.name: multiple press-release cycles
hiddenCases.explanation: Debouncer should remain correct over repeated transitions.

hiddenCases.name: initial high then fall
hiddenCases.explanation: Initialization path should support either initial level.

hiddenCases.name: alternating noise
hiddenCases.explanation: Pure bounce/noise must not trigger transitions.

hiddenCases.name: bounce both directions
hiddenCases.displayExpect: exactly one rise and one fall
